title: Tahan rakyat Malaysia, polis Thai rampas 20kg bunga ganja
summary: NARATHIWAT (THAILAND): Polis Thailand menahan seorang rakyat Malaysia dan merampas bunga ganja seberat 20 kilogram (kg) semasa melalui pusat Pemeriksaan Kastam Padang Besar, Daerah Sadao, Songkhla, di sini semalam. title_en: Thai police seize 20kg of marijuana flowers after arresting Malaysian national
summary_en: NARATHIWAT (THAILAND): Thai police arrested a Malaysian citizen and seized 20 kilograms of marijuana flowers while crossing the Padang Besar Customs Checkpoint, Sadao District, Songkhla here yesterday. title: Five security volunteers injured in pipe bomb attack in Yala
summary: Two homemade pipe bombs were thrown into a security unit’s operational base in Bannang Sata district, Yala province late on Thursday evening, leaving five security volunteers injured.
